text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: "Symboli Rudolf has done it! The Triple Crown is hers! An immortal, monumental record!!"

text_block_list.name: Young Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Waaah~~...!
She's so coo—... *cough, cough*!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi's Older Sister
text_block_list.text:
! Tsu-chan.
...Here, throat lozenge.

text_block_list.name: Young Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, thanks~.
*nom*...

text_block_list.name: Young Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"...You know, Sis.
Rudolf-san took a break once too, you know.
But she healed up properly and won her next race."

text_block_list.name: Young Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"So future me is gonna be
a suuuper strong Umamusume too. Totally!"

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
—It's finally time for my debut race.
Just a little longer... Alllriiight!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Today is 100 forward skips!
Hup, hup—huh?

text_block_list.name: King's Entourage
text_block_list.text:
Amaaazing King!
Go for it~, King~!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ohoho! Bring on 200 or 300!
For King, nothing is impossible!

text_block_list.name: King's Entourage
text_block_list.text: Kyaaah~♪

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I'm doing 500 toooooo!!
Uoooooooooh!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me~! Traineeer~!
I overdid it~~!!
choice_data_list: Ah, yeah... So, how's your ankle feeling?
Y-yeah... So how's the pain in your ankle?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
It's gone down a bit!
So as for training—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Aww...
Is that a nooo...?
As she mopes, I turn a stern glare toward her and rack my brain for a solution.
—Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi's body is frail.

Normally, once an Umamusume enters her "breakthrough" phase,
her racing abilities begin to develop
at an exponential rate.
My strength and physical condition are improving, and there are signs I don't tire easily under heavy loads, but...
choice_data_list: (It won't change your natural constitution, though.)

text_block_list.text:
Even after Awakening, one must treat
the body they were born with carefully.

Having sorted out my thoughts, I took out my laptop.
Her challenges were clear. In that case—
choice_data_list: Tsuyoshi, now is the time for 'proper effort' to shine

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: "Proper effort"...—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: —Ah!!

The next day, before training,
I called Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi over
to discuss our future regimen.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
"So 'proper effort' means...
in other words, putting in the right kind of effort!"
choice_data_list: Yeah, that's true, but I'll explain just in case.

text_block_list.text:
I turn the laptop screen toward her and show her
the 'Training Regimen Until Debut Race' materials.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see.
"To bring out your best performance in your debut race"...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
As for our policy, we'll prioritize the Fitness-Fatigue Model over the Supercompensation Theory.
While reducing volume to alleviate fatigue—

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: This is tough...
choice_data_list: ...Alright! Could you check this side first, then?
...Alright! Could you check this side first, then?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Um...
"Aside from tapering, another crucial point
to keep in mind is 'proper nutrition before and after exercise'"!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Like meat buns or bananas after a workout.
Oho... that sounds quite good...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: On the other hand, about an hour before exercising, juice rich in vitamins, minerals, and carbohydrates is—
choice_data_list: Yeah, like that orange juice and such.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Ah, vitamins!
So that's why you gave me juice
instead of a sports drink—...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Uwoooaagh~!?
I-Is this really what the "right kind of effort" looks like~~!?

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Ooooh...

When training an athlete's body,
simply increasing the number of reps
isn't always the right answer.

Transforming the quality and content into appropriate effort based on theory.
That is precisely what I envision as 'proper effort.'
choice_data_list: Alright, Tsuyoshi! Time to start putting in 'proper effort'!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: ――! Yes!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
The me that you're going to raise,
I feel like I'm going to become a whole new person!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
......Hmph...
Phew...! Hah-phew...!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Oooooh!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Piece of cake! A load like this is nothing for El, no problem-o-o-o-o-o!!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. I'll pretend not to notice your arms trembling like a newborn fawn.
Now thenâ

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: —...Hmph, hah...!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
......Ooh...!
On such grueling equipment, too...
choice_data_list: Tsuyoshi! Focus on your own training!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...! Yes!!
Phew...! Haaah...!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
The right kind of effort...!
Make sure you're putting in the right kind of effort, Tsuyoshi~~!!
choice_data_list: That's right, you will "definitely" deliver when it counts.
Right, you *definitely* deliver results when it counts.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Yeeees!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: I am DEFINITELY gonna get stronger!!!
And so, the days accumulated—all dedicated to "giving it everything in the debut race."
—And so came the day of the debut race.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
...O-Ohh.
Ohhh...

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOOOAAAH~~~!
Trainer! Traaainer!
Traaaaiineeeerrr!!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Somehow—my body feels so light!
Like my whole body is... super pumped!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: I might actually be amazing today!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Yes!!

From my side as well, preparations are meant to be perfect.
I smile back at her as she bounds with excitement.

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Um, excuse me,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
I'll bring back great results!
So please, just sit back and watch with confidence!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text: Tsuyoshi is heading out!!

All that proper effort must have given her wings.
I saw her off to the paddock as she took flight toward
the stage of her Debut race.
